title: Vikram and Betal: The Wise Choice
moral: Always choose what is right, not what is easy.

scenes.summary: Betal tells a story about a boy’s choice.
scenes.text: Betal told Vikram about a boy who had to choose between two paths.
scenes.image_prompt: vikram carrying betal in forest cartoon style

scenes.text: One path was easy but wrong, the other was hard but right.
scenes.image_prompt: boy standing at two paths thinking cartoon

scenes.summary: The boy chooses the difficult path.
scenes.text: The boy chose the harder but right path.
scenes.image_prompt: boy walking on difficult path cartoon

scenes.text: The boy learned many things and improved.
scenes.image_prompt: boy learning and growing confident cartoon

scenes.text: The boy became successful. Vikram answered wisely, and Betal flew away.

story: A boy chose a difficult but right path and succeeded, while others chose the easy path and failed. Vikram said right choices lead to success.
